input.title: [Mobile] Gesture alerts immediately disappear when swiping quickly
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

1. Create thought `Foo`. 
2. Swipe slowly to create a `New Thought` gesture
3. Swipe quickly to create a `New Thought` gesture

## Current Behavior

When swiping slowly (2), the `New Thought` notice appears and does not disappear until the correct timeout.

When swiping quickly (3), the `New Thought` notice appears and immediately disappears.

<details>
<summary>Demo (current/old alert design)</summary>

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2f8e28a1-d482-438a-b0cb-9ac2692c3927
</details>

<details>
<summary>Demo (new alert design)</summary>

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0b2090f-8f10-4573-8951-92b47006b5bf
</details>

## Expected Behavior

The `New Thought` notice should always remain until the correct timeout. It should not disappear immediately as in (3).
